id.description: The ID of the activity record.

user_guid.description: The GUID of the user that visited the content. May be null when the content does not require a user session.

content_guid.description: The GUID of the content this activity pertains to.

timestamp.description: The timestamp (RFC3339) when the user visited the content.

data.description: Additional data about the content hit.

ContentHitData.description: Additional data about a content hit.

path.description: The path consumed for this hit event.

query.description: The query string for this hit event.

user_agent.description: The user agent registered for this hit event.

sec_fetch_dest.description: The value of the Sec-Fetch-Dest HTTP header. Common values: document, iframe, empty.

sec_fetch_site.description: The value of the Sec-Fetch-Site HTTP header. Common values: same-origin, same-site, cross-site, none.
